explain: Line x cosα+y sinα=p in slope form: slope m=−cosα/sinα; tangency: p/sinα=a/m → p sinα+a cos²α=0.

subject: Mathematics
prompt: Focal distance of point (at²,2at) on y²=4ax from focus is?
explain: Focal distance = x₁+a = at²+a = a(1+t²) using focus-directrix definition.
